semiconductor_relevance: High — NCK Co., Ltd. produces advanced polymer liquid compounds specifically for the semiconductor industry.
summary: NCK Co., Ltd. is a key supplier of advanced polymer liquid compounds for the semiconductor and display industries. Their flagship product, ARC® coating, is designed to support various linewidths in semiconductor manufacturing, contributing to technological advancements.

regional_presence.Korea: NCK collaborates with major domestic corporations to enhance electronic materials development.
